editorial.blurb: Susupuato is a warm, welcoming Mexican gem where the food is as memorable as the service—Tony and the team treat you like family from the moment you walk in.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask Tony to teach you how to do a tequila shot, and don't miss their complimentary shots and soup—the staff loves taking care of regulars with these surprise perks.

topDishes.note: reviewers rave about this signature dish across multiple visits
incredibly flavorful meats that keep people coming back
